entry.title: Pont de l'Archeveche
entry.note: Exact mapped bridge axis and flared mainland approach. Modeled island road end approximately 34.60 m agrees with the independent upper-bank plateau at native X 40–44 m (34.58–34.60 m); the closer X 33 m terrain ray is on the smoothed quay face. Mainland plateau differences up to 0.4 m are retained.
